description: This file contains functions for handling platform-specific upgrade procedures for a Linux-based embedded system. It includes functions for verifying image compatibility, copying configuration data, performing upgrades, and handling partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the upgrade image's partition layout matches the current disk's layout.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to a specified partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Executes the device upgrade process, including partition checks, image writing, and UUID updates.
